thread:
robin (PM): quick proposal for a Visibility Lite deliverable for the next sprint. focus = high-value, low-cost surface that we can push to a pilot cohort. targets:
- dashboard panels: model-cost-by-route, tail-latency (99/95 pctiles), and error-fingerprint-trends (24h/7d)
- adaptive trace hooks: low baseline sampling with QPS-driven upsamples on hot endpoints
- console per-route cost breakdown showing token, compute, network columns + top models per route
- searchable error analytics with fuzzy fingerprint grouping and a "repro attempt" link

Goals: make 90% of customers get useful insights without touching config, keep infra overhead low, and provide clear rollback/guardrails. need quick alignment on sampling defaults, retention, acceptance criteria, and owners.

taylor (eng): sounds good. for adaptive traces i propose default_sample: 0.01 and an upsample rule when route_qps > 50 => sample 0.5 for that route for 30m. store full traces 3d, but keep aggregated span metrics 14d. example config: 
```yaml
adaptive_sampling:
  default: 0.01
  rules:
    - match: "/v1/generate*"
      condition: qps > 50
      sample: 0.5
      ttl_minutes: 30
```
we should also expose a per-org override in console.

sam (infra): retention plan ok but need to cap max daily trace events per org. suggest quota: 500k traces/day/org for GA; if exceeded, auto-throttle and notify owner. also want the sampling rules controllable by feature-flag to tweak live.

rachel (SRE): agree on quotas. add two operational checks: 1) alert on trace pipeline lag > 2m, 2) spike detection (ingest > 3x baseline for 5m) to trigger throttle. for rollout: canary to 10% orgs, monitor ingestion and error-noise for 48h before increasing.

jas (data): for dashboard queries i'll need a consistent event shape: "route_id, model_id, tokens, infra_cost_usd, network_cost_usd, duration_ms, status_code". sample query for model-cost-by-route: 
```sql
SELECT route_id, model_id, SUM(tokens) AS tokens, SUM(infra_cost_usd+network_cost_usd) AS total_cost
FROM telemetry.events
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY route_id, model_id
ORDER BY total_cost DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
we can precompute daily aggregates to keep dashboard latency low.

robin (PM): acceptance criteria proposal: 
- dashboards: template available + one pilot org onboarded + docs/how-to in console
- traces: end-to-end p50/p95 overhead < 1.5% at 5k rps with default sampling; aggregation pipeline latency < 30s for metrics panels
- cost breakdown: per-route table + top-3 model contributors exposed in UI for last 7d
- error analytics: dedupe fuzzy fingerprints and surface top 5 actionable groups in last 24h
- rollout: canary 10% orgs -> monitor 48h -> expand, automatic rollback on throttle or >10% false-positive error grouping increase

robin (PM): owners: taylor -> trace SDK + middleware + adaptive logic, jas -> cost aggregates + panel queries, sam -> infra quotas + feature-flag, rachel -> alerts + runbook. i'll own pilot invites and customer comms.

taylor (eng): timeline ask: mini spike for SDK + middleware by Tue EOD, dashboard aggregates + sample panels by Fri, and a joint SRE/infra test run next Mon. engineers: @taylor, @jas.

sam (infra): i'll wire feature-flag and quota enforcement; plan to surface quota usage in console to pilot orgs.

rachel (SRE): i'll draft the runbook pages and add the two alerts to our SLO dashboard. also want an e2e test that simulates 10% above QPS threshold to validate upsampling behavior.

robin (PM): risks: accidental over-sampling, high-cardinality model tags flooding UI, and ambiguous error groups. mitigations: strict default limits, cardinality caps in UI (show top N with "more"), and a simple "confirm grouping" toggle to allow human review before auto-aggregations.

obs-bot: epic created: VIS-LITE-Q1, link: https://redwood.internal/epics/VIS-LITE-Q1 (owner: robin).

jas (data): UX suggestion: add a toggle in the cost panel to switch between token-only and total-cost view and an export CSV button. that helps customers analyze tradeoffs quickly.

robin (PM): action items: 
- taylor: SDK + middleware PR (due Tue EOD)
- jas: aggregated queries + sample panels (due Fri)
- sam: feature-flag + quota enforcement + console usage meter (due Fri)
- rachel: alerts + runbook + e2e test plan (due Mon)

please react with :thumbsup: on your item and ping if timeline doesn't work. i'll pull this into the roadmap board once we have thumbs and link to the epic. thanks! :white_check_mark:
